Class GameStatusManager

java.lang.Object
app.model.multi.GameStatusManager
public class GameStatusManager extends Object
GameStatusManager is a class responsible for managing the state of the game, including turn tracking, timing, and various statuses such as user actions, turn passing, and game effects.

    • nextTurn

      public void nextTurn()
      Advances the game to the next player's turn, based on the current turn order. Determines the next player by applying the turn order, which can be positive or negative, to the current turn, and adjusts for modular arithmetic to ensure valid player indices.

      If the order is negative, the method computes the next turn by decrementing the current turn and wrapping around in case of negative results. If the order is positive, the method computes the next turn by incrementing the current turn and applying modular arithmetic to ensure the turn index remains within the range of valid players.

      The result is updated in the `turn` variable, ensuring it correctly points to the next active player.

    • setReverseOrder

      public void setReverseOrder()
      Reverses the current turn order in the game.

      This method negates the value of the internal `order` variable, effectively reversing the direction in which turns progress in the game. If the turn order was previously moving in a positive direction, it will now move in a negative direction, and vice versa.

      This is typically used to modify gameplay flow, such as in response to specific game events or conditions that require reversing the turn sequence.
